imports.description: Import patients, stock items with opening stock, or prices from Excel: check every row first, then import.

patients.title: Patients
patients.description: Patient files with duplicate checks against existing files.
patients.columns: Columns: name (Arabic or English) and sex are required; date of birth or age, phone, address, national ID and emergency contact are optional.

items.title: Stock items and opening stock
items.description: Drugs and consumables with their units, batches, expiry dates and opening quantities.
items.columns: One row per batch. Service code, generic name and base unit describe the item (a new code also needs a name); batch number, expiry date, quantity in base units, cost and store add opening stock, which is received as a goods receipt.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: Service prices into a price list version that starts after today.
prices.columns: Columns: service code and price (SDG) are required; a service name column is ignored. Services not in the file keep their current price.

imports.kindNotAllowed: You do not have the permission for this import.
imports.storeNone: None: every row names its store
imports.storeHint: Used for batch rows whose store column is empty.
imports.effectiveHint: Prices on approved invoices never change: imported prices go into a version that starts after today.
imports.fileHint: First sheet, header row first, up to 2,000 rows and 5 MB. Formulas are not accepted.
imports.uploadFailed: The file could not be checked
imports.caption: Rows of {{file}}
imports.includeDuplicates_one: Also import the possible duplicate (you checked it)
imports.includeDuplicates_other: Also import the {{count}} possible duplicates (you checked them)
imports.errorsNotImported: Rows with errors are never imported.
imports.itemsNote: New items are created in the catalog and the pharmacy; opening stock is received through a goods receipt from the opening-stock supplier, one per store.
imports.pricesNote: Prices go into price list {{list}} from {{date}}.
imports.confirmDescription_one: Import {{count}} row? This cannot be undone from this screen.
imports.confirmDescription_other: Import {{count}} rows? This cannot be undone from this screen.
imports.batchLine: Batch {{batch, bidi}} · expires {{expiry, bidi}} · {{qty}} in {{store, bidi}}

hint.national_id: Same national ID as file {{fileNo, bidi}} ({{name}})
hint.name_dob: Similar name and birth date to file {{fileNo, bidi}} ({{name}})
hint.item_exists: The item already exists: its details are kept, only the batch is added
hint.batch_exists: This batch already exists for the item
hint.stock_exists: The item already has {{onHand}} in stock: importing adds to it

system.description: Server, database, disk space, backups, restore tests and updates.
system.backupNowDescription: The backup service starts it within a minute or two and records the result here. The system stays usable meanwhile.

DB_UNAVAILABLE.title: Database not reachable
DB_UNAVAILABLE.description: The application cannot query the database. Check the db service.

BACKUP_STATUS_UNAVAILABLE.title: Backup logs not available
BACKUP_STATUS_UNAVAILABLE.description: The backup status folder is not mounted, so backups cannot be checked from here.

BACKUP_STALE.title: No recent backup
BACKUP_STALE.description: There is no successful backup from the last 36 hours.

BACKUP_FAILED.title: The last backup failed
BACKUP_FAILED.description: Read the error below and fix it before tonight's backup.

RESTORE_TEST_STALE.title: No recent restore test
RESTORE_TEST_STALE.description: No restore test passed in the last 35 days.

RESTORE_TEST_FAILED.title: The last restore test failed
RESTORE_TEST_FAILED.description: A backup that cannot be restored is not a backup. Check the restore test log.

DISK_LOW.title: Disk space low
DISK_LOW.description: Less than 10% free on a disk. Free space or add a disk.

MIGRATIONS_PENDING.title: Database update pending
MIGRATIONS_PENDING.description: The database schema is behind the application. Run the update procedure.

system.allGoodDescription: The database answers, backups are recent and restore tests pass.

request.pending: Backup requested, waiting for the backup service

system.requestHint: Refresh in a minute to see the result.
system.noDisks: Disk space could not be read.
system.pendingCloud_one: {{count}} backup waiting for the cloud upload.
system.pendingCloud_other: {{count}} backups waiting for the cloud upload.
system.noUpdates: No update has been recorded yet.

export.description: Download all patients, visits, invoices, payments, stock moves and claims as CSV files in one zip.
export.format: Every column of every row, UTF-8 CSV (opens in Excel with Arabic text), with a README describing the files.
export.sensitive: The export holds personal and financial data of every patient. Keep the file safe, do not send it by chat or email, and delete copies you no longer need. Every export is recorded with your name.
export.working: Preparing the export. Large centers may wait a minute.

audit.description: Every change to a record: who made it, when, why, and the values before and after.
audit.caption: Audit events
